target.outcome: Daily instantaneous COVID-19 case-fatality risk (back-projected deaths / cases in article; fixed 8-day death-shift proxy in fitted sensitivity)
target.geography: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales, nation-day
target.population: Laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 cases in the four UK nations
target.exposure_assignment: Article: daily nation monitor mean; fit: hourly modeled PM2.5 at nation centroid, daily mean, then 11-day mean
target.model: Article: binomial mixed DLNM; fit: binomial logit GLM with robust covariance and an 11-day linear lag-average predictor
target.named_outcome_source: PHE/ONS in article; public GitHub preservation of UK dashboard indicators in fit

substitutions.reanalysis: Open-Meteo atmospheric-composition PM2.5 at nation centroids
substitutions.reason: AERIS historical monitor batch did not complete during this run.
Exact delay distribution and author outcome extract were unavailable.
Recovered archive ended 2020-08-01 and alignment removes subsequent dates.

substitutions.published: nonlinear DLNM cross-bases and country random effect
substitutions.reanalysis: linear 11-day mean with country fixed effects
substitutions.reason: A bounded, executable fit retained the binomial family and lag window but cannot reproduce spline DLNM.

coverage.rule: Complete cases after 11 daily exposure/covariate observations and fixed 8-day death alignment; no numerical coverage threshold.
coverage.notes: 449 nation-day rows fitted. All four nations retained; public outcome archive and alignment limited usable calendar dates.

blockers: AERIS/OpenAQ administrative-boundary historical PM2.5 job remained running without durable output.
Exact backprojNP delay distribution and full-period official outcome extract were not recovered.

design_provenance.assignment_method: Daily hourly PM2.5 values queried at the four centroids, then arithmetic daily mean and 11-day (lag 0 through 10) rolling mean per nation.
design_provenance.monitor_distance_evidence: Not applicable to the selected assignment method.
design_provenance.exposure_metric: Nation-day PM2.5 concentration in µg/m³; main predictor is the 11-day mean, parameterized per 10 µg/m³.

coverage_policy.evidence: Report-only. Fit uses complete cases after necessary 11-day lag and fixed 8-day outcome alignment; no data-driven exposure threshold or outcome selection.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: The article specifies daily country averages and a 10-day maximum lag. The selected implementation retains daily country-time support and lag scale, while explicitly labeling the coordinate-based modeled PM2.5 source as a substitution.
evidence_basis: All four nations have hourly-derived daily PM2.5 and complete 11-day lag values over recovered outcome dates.
Fit-ready rows and outcome coverage are retained by nation.
Documents active but non-completing OpenAQ boundary route and the public source recovery choices.

reported_variants: Article Model 6 specified but not exactly identifiable
Bounded source-substituted linear 11-day binomial GLM fitted
